The Gold Card

A letter that keeps talking after it's opened.

A gold card that comes with your gift. They tap it with their phone, and a note from you opens on screen. Each time they tap, it can show a different message, depending on the time of day.

  1. 1. A gold card arrives

    Tucked in with your gift.

  2. 2. They tap it with their phone

    No app, no download. A printed QR code works too.

  3. 3. A note from you opens

    Add your voice, photos or a song.

How it works

One message. 48 to 72 hours.

Tell us what you want to say. Every letter is written for one person, never copied. It arrives sealed in wax.

  1. Written
  2. Sealed
  3. Packed
  4. Delivered
How delivery works
  1. Pick your date. Choose the day you want it to arrive when you order.
  2. Approve your letter. We send you the words first. Nothing is sealed until you say yes.
  3. Sealed and packed. Wax seal, then the box, then it goes out with a rider.
  4. Arrives on your date in Lagos. The fee is fixed by area, so you know the full price before you pay.

Good to know

Questions, answered

Can I write the message myself?

Yes. Choose “I know what to say” when you start your letter and type it exactly as you want it, word for word. We'll still send it to you to read before we seal it.

What if I don't know what to write?

That's what we're here for. Choose “Help me find the words”, share their name, your story, and a few memories or nicknames, and we'll turn it into a letter they'll keep. We never make up memories — the details come from you.

How long does it take to make my order?

Most orders are ready in less than 48 hours. The checkout only offers delivery dates we can make. For busy seasons like Valentine's Day, order early — places are limited.

How much does it cost?

Prices are shown on each product, and the delivery fee for your area is added before you pay, so you see the full total first. Some flowers and deliveries outside our listed areas are quoted on request.

Do you deliver outside Lagos?

Yes, we deliver nationwide. Choose “Another state” at checkout and we'll confirm the delivery fee and timing before you pay.

Can I order for a specific date and time?

Yes. Choose the date at checkout and tell us your preferred time window. We'll plan delivery around it.
